mapper.sql: c.tenant_id,c.integration_id,c.group_binding_id,c.command_id,c.target_ref,c.fingerprint,c.expected_revision,c.accepted_revision,c.desired_state,COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(s.scope ORDER BY s.scope) FROM nw_group_control_command_scopes s WHERE (s.tenant_id,s.integration_id,s.group_binding_id,s.command_id)=(c.tenant_id,c.integration_id,c.group_binding_id,c.command_id)),'[]'::jsonb)::text AS scopes_json,c.actor_principal,c.result_kind,c.result_ref,c.response_json::text AS response_json,c.local_intent_id

e.tenant_id,e.integration_id,e.group_binding_id,e.endpoint_id,e.generation,e.ledger_ref,e.principal_id,e.status,e.applied_revision,e.fence_revision,e.applied_boundary_ref,e.retirement_receipt_ref,COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('delivery_id',f.delivery_id,'status',f.status,'result_ref',f.result_ref) ORDER BY f.delivery_id) FROM nw_group_sender_endpoint_flights f WHERE (f.tenant_id,f.integration_id,f.group_binding_id,f.endpoint_id,f.generation)=(e.tenant_id,e.integration_id,e.group_binding_id,e.endpoint_id,e.generation)),'[]'::jsonb)::text AS in_flight_json,e.last_ack_at AS last_confirmed_at
mapper.select: SELECT id AS group_binding_id,tenant_id,integration_id,namespace,external_group_ref,lifecycle_ref,business_scope_id,session_id,status,revision FROM nw_group_bindings WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND integration_id=#{integration} AND id=#{group}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_group_control_groups(tenant_id,integration_id,group_binding_id) VALUES(#{tenant},#{integration},#{group}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,integration_id,group_binding_id,revision,latest_trigger_sequence FROM nw_group_control_groups WHERE FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_group_control_groups SET revision=revision+1 WHERE AND revision=#{expected}
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,integration_id,group_binding_id,target_ref,scope,paused,revision FROM nw_group_control_states WHERE ORDER BY target_ref,scope
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_group_control_states(tenant_id,integration_id,group_binding_id,target_ref,scope,paused,revision) VALUES(#{tenantId},#{integrationId},#{groupBindingId},#{targetRef},#{scope},#{paused},#{revision}) ON CONFLICT(tenant_id,integration_id,group_binding_id,target_ref,scope) DO UPDATE SET paused=excluded.paused,revision=excluded.revision WHERE nw_group_control_states.revision < excluded.revision
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,integration_id,group_binding_id,boundary_ref,target_ref,through_sequence,control_revision FROM nw_group_control_boundaries WHERE ORDER BY control_revision,boundary_ref
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_group_control_boundaries SET through_sequence=#{through} WHERE AND target_ref=#{target} AND through_sequence IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT FROM nw_group_control_commands c WHERE AND command_id=#{id}
SELECT FROM nw_group_control_commands c WHERE AND result_kind='accepted' ORDER BY accepted_revision DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_group_control_participants(tenant_id,integration_id,group_binding_id,command_id,revision,endpoint_id,generation,status) VALUES(#{tenantId},#{integrationId},#{groupBindingId},#{commandId},#{revision},#{endpointId},#{generation},#{status}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,integration_id,group_binding_id,command_id,revision,endpoint_id,generation,status FROM nw_group_control_participants WHERE AND command_id=#{command} ORDER BY endpoint_id,generation

SELECT tenant_id,integration_id,group_binding_id,command_id,revision,endpoint_id,generation,ledger_ref,applied_boundary_ref,fence_revision,actor_principal FROM nw_group_control_acks WHERE AND command_id=#{command} ORDER BY endpoint_id,generation
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_group_control_acks(tenant_id,integration_id,group_binding_id,command_id,revision,endpoint_id,generation,ledger_ref,applied_boundary_ref,fence_revision,actor_principal) VALUES(#{tenantId},#{integrationId},#{groupBindingId},#{commandId},#{revision},#{endpointId},#{generation},#{ledgerRef},#{appliedBoundaryRef},#{fenceRevision},#{actorPrincipal}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT FROM nw_group_sender_endpoints e WHERE ORDER BY endpoint_id,generation
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_group_sender_endpoints SET status='RETIRING' WHERE AND endpoint_id=#{endpoint} AND generation=#{generation} AND status IN('REGISTERING','ACTIVE')

UPDATE nw_group_sender_endpoints SET status='RETIRED',fence_revision=#{fence},retirement_receipt_ref=#{receipt},applied_boundary_ref=#{boundary} WHERE AND endpoint_id=#{endpoint} AND generation=#{generation} AND status='RETIRING' AND fence_revision < #{fence}

UPDATE nw_group_sender_endpoints SET applied_revision=#{revision},fence_revision=#{fence},applied_boundary_ref=#{boundary},status='ACTIVE',last_ack_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE AND endpoint_id=#{endpoint} AND generation=#{generation} AND status IN('REGISTERING','ACTIVE') AND applied_revision <= #{revision} AND fence_revision <= #{fence}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM nw_group_sender_endpoint_flights WHERE AND endpoint_id=#{endpoint} AND generation=#{generation}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_group_send_eligibilities(tenant_id,integration_id,group_binding_id,trigger_id,trigger_sequence,registered_revision) VALUES(#{tenantId},#{integrationId},#{groupBindingId},#{triggerId},#{triggerSequence},#{registeredRevision}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_group_control_groups SET latest_trigger_sequence=#{sequence} WHERE AND latest_trigger_sequence < #{sequence}
mapper.select: SELECT e.tenant_id,e.integration_id,e.group_binding_id,e.trigger_id,e.trigger_sequence,e.registered_revision,t.run_id FROM nw_group_send_eligibilities e JOIN nw_group_triggers t USING(tenant_id,integration_id,group_binding_id,trigger_id) WHERE e.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND e.group_binding_id=#{group} AND e.trigger_id=#{trigger}

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM agent_runtime_execution_runs r JOIN nw_group_bindings g ON g.tenant_id::text=r.tenant_id AND g.id::text=r.subject_id WHERE g.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND g.integration_id=#{integration} AND g.id=#{group} AND r.run_id=#{run} AND r.subject_kind='GROUP')

SELECT 'runtime:'||r.run_id||':'||a.attempt_id AS delivery_id,CASE WHEN a.result_kind='UNKNOWN' THEN 'UNKNOWN' ELSE 'DISPATCHING' END AS status,a.result_ref FROM agent_runtime_execution_runs r JOIN nw_group_triggers t ON t.tenant_id::text=r.tenant_id AND r.origin_ref='group-trigger:'||t.trigger_id AND t.group_binding_id=#{group} AND t.integration_id=#{integration} JOIN agent_runtime_execution_attempts a ON a.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND a.run_id=r.run_id WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenant}::text AND (#{target}='*' OR r.run_id=#{target} OR t.run_id=#{target}) AND (a.result_kind IS NULL OR a.result_kind='UNKNOWN') ORDER BY r.run_id,a.attempt_id

SELECT tenant_id,integration_id,group_binding_id,actor_principal,operation,request_key,fingerprint,response_json::text AS response_json FROM nw_group_control_requests WHERE AND actor_principal=#{actor} AND operation=#{operation} AND request_key=#{key}
SELECT tenant_id,integration_id,group_binding_id,delivery_id,run_id,message_id,message_version,trigger_id,content_digest FROM nw_group_deliveries WHERE AND delivery_id=#{id}

SELECT tenant_id,integration_id,group_binding_id,delivery_id,run_id,message_id,message_version,trigger_id,content_digest FROM nw_group_deliveries WHERE AND run_id=#{run} AND message_id=#{message} AND message_version=#{version}
SELECT DISTINCT boundary_ref FROM nw_group_delivery_release_boundaries WHERE AND delivery_id=#{delivery} ORDER BY boundary_ref
